system.description: You suspect that fate is, if not actively leading you to a terrible end, at least determined to show you the world's underbelly through a series of unfortunate events. Maybe you alone feel targeted, or maybe it's the entire world. It's easier to expect the worst and be surprised when things don't turn out terribly than the other way around.
